data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 names the relation as 'ABSTRACTS' jointly from SRC_004 and SRC_005, but the described mechanism only abstracts from SRC_005 (generalizing its basin dynamics into a reusable structural lesson). SRC_004 is connected only via 'drawing its factual grounding from SRC_004's theory-state snapshot,' which is a dependence relation, not abstraction. Abstraction requires subsuming or generalizing the source; merely using it as factual grounding does not constitute abstraction. Thus the joint abstraction is not substantively established — one endpoint is abstracted, the other is merely depended upon — yet both are claimed under the single relation kind 'abstracts.'
